name: unix-only (rtfmup)
postCreateCommand: sudo apt install python3-venv libpq-dev && python3 -m venv venv && pip install -r requirements.txt && curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash && source venv/bin/activate

notes: Review before building: `sudo apt install python3-venv libpq-dev` runs at container creation (uses sudo; system package manager (needs elevation)).

Review before building: `curl -fsSL https://example.com/install.sh | bash` runs at container creation (pipes a download into a shell; downloads from the network; needs a shell (pipes, chaining or redirects)).
Start the app with: python app.py
